_comment: T-4889: per shape the rate k6 holds (req/s, open model) for `duration`, and the budget surfaces_gate.py judges: p95/p99 in ms, errors in %, throughput at least 95 % of rate. `tolerance`: p99 may exceed a same-machine baseline by this share.

ngsi-id.reason: a page or one entity a person waits on: OPS-18's p95 50 ms for a read, p99 three times that for a shared runner's tail

ngsi-type.reason: a page or one entity a person waits on: OPS-18's p95 50 ms for a read, p99 three times that for a shared runner's tail

ngsi-q.reason: a filtered, geo or translated query behind a map or a grid: under 200 ms p95 the redraw reads as instant; p99 500 ms

ngsi-near.reason: a filtered, geo or translated query behind a map or a grid: under 200 ms p95 the redraw reads as instant; p99 500 ms

ngsi-within.reason: a filtered, geo or translated query behind a map or a grid: under 200 ms p95 the redraw reads as instant; p99 500 ms

ngsi-attrs.reason: a page or one entity a person waits on: OPS-18's p95 50 ms for a read, p99 three times that for a shared runner's tail; attrs narrows the answer, so it costs no more than the page

temporal-lastn.reason: a chart's newest ten values: the read budget

temporal-between.reason: a week of a 30-day series behind a chart: the query budget

upsert-100.reason: a pipeline's batch of 100 at 500 entities/s: a batch under 0.5 s keeps a one-second ingest tick

view-type.reason: a page or one entity a person waits on: OPS-18's p95 50 ms for a read, p99 three times that for a shared runner's tail; the view root must stay within the root's budget (ADR-0027 section 6)

odata.reason: a filtered, geo or translated query behind a map or a grid: under 200 ms p95 the redraw reads as instant; p99 500 ms ($filter, $orderby, $count)

ogc-items.reason: a filtered, geo or translated query behind a map or a grid: under 200 ms p95 the redraw reads as instant; p99 500 ms (bbox + CQL2)

ogc-page.reason: a GIS client paging a collection 50 Features at a time: the query budget

sta-things.reason: Things with their Datastreams expanded and counted: the query budget

sta-observations.reason: a Datastream's Observations after a time: the query budget

ical.reason: the whole 5 000-Event feed: calendar clients poll it every 15 min or more, so 2 s p95 is the bound

mcp.reason: an agent's tools/call query_entities inside a model turn: the query budget

ws-fanout.reason: write-to-socket delivery at 200 writes/s to 1 000 subscribers (50 per write): a live map lags a write by under 250 ms p95; no notification lost
